paragraphs.html: We assessed how the Victorian Labor election platform would impact the latest Victorian budget update – the 2022 Victorian Pre-Election Budget Update, released on 10 November 2022. We estimate budget impact for the period corresponding with the 2022 Victorian Pre-Election Budget Update (to 2025–26) and over the next parliament (to 2026–27) where possible – budget aggregates, like net debt, only exist to 2025–26.

paragraphs.html: The change in net position indicates the overall impact of these election policies on the Victorian budget. It is similar to a change in net debt and measures the gap between the government’s operating revenue and expenses, and movements in assets. A positive change indicates that these election policies would improve the net position of the budget.
